summary: Verified that E-FIX-GO closes the XR-GO empty-Arg inference finding while retaining Update reachability, exact typed gobi.Effect, and literal kind/name/reply controls without app-ID hardcoding.
verified_properties: The cancellation descriptor scan is rooted at the component Update symbol and follows Update-reachable helpers; it does not filter on an application or package ID.
The effect element type is derived from Update's second result slice and still must be github.com/samuelpmahan/gondola/gobi.Effect with string Kind, Name, Arg, and Reply fields.
Arg must be present and string-typed. Its payload content no longer gates the capability, so direct Arg: "" and parenthesized Arg: ("") infer effect.cancel consistently.

Kind, Name, and Reply still require literal strings equal to lifecycle.cancel, cancel, and empty string. Computed protocol fields still fail closed; keyed field form and Update reachability remain required.

Analyzer controls still cover mismatched protocol values, unrelated text, unreachable construction, and a computed Kind; the empty direct and parenthesized Arg regression cases are both present and pass.
AppIR contract validation still accepts effect.cancel and rejects duplicate capability declarations.
limitations: This review was limited to the compiler contract and analyzer changes associated with E-GO/XR-GO/E-FIX-GO. The full capability milestone runner was not part of the requested verification.
integration: The original XR-GO amendment remains recorded as amend; E-FIX-GO closes that finding and is accepted.
publication: This review made no production edits. No commit, merge, or deploy was performed.
